design.heads: one linear readout with 3 outputs; loss masked to the arm's task set
design.folds: GroupKFold(5) on doi over the union of endpoints
design.budget_matching: every epoch sees exactly the potency-only row count; auxiliary rows are subsampled to fill the remainder

leakage.reading: cisplatin_ratio is derived from the cisplatin-sensitive / resistant pair, so a high share means aux_both is not an independent task

verdict_rule: PASS iff best potency delta >= 0.02 AND no auxiliary endpoint drops > 0.02
caveats: One seed. Optimizer steps per epoch ARE matched (budget_rows_per_epoch), so a gain cannot come from simply seeing more rows; it can still come from the gradient mix within a batch.
phototoxicity has 2,158 rows against 21,404 potency rows, so its gradient share is ~10% even when it is present.
The shared encoder is the only thing regularised; each endpoint still has its own output column, so a null result means the shared representation did not improve.
